transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I’m sure the contractor and some people on my block have been working together to cheat us. It’s been going on nearly two years. They keep leaving my kitchen half-wrong on purpose, no matter what excuses they give or what receipts my husband shows me.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds when no one else was around?
No, I haven’t noticed anything like that.
Over the past several weeks or months, how has your mood been feeling—have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless?
I’m not sure I’d say depressed or hopeless. I’ve been upset and frustrated about what’s been going on, but I wouldn’t call it hopeless.
Do you have any diagnosed medical conditions or physical health problems?
I don’t have any diagnosed medical conditions that I know of.
Outside of this situation with the contractor and your neighbors, do you generally feel you can trust the people around you?

Generally, yes, but with this, no. For nearly two years I’ve been sure the contractor and some people on my block have been working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen half-wrong on purpose. They keep giving excuses, even with all the receipts my husband has shown them.
